summary: Ann Arbor, Michigan, former board member of Inter-Cooperative Council, strong advocate for student-athlete welfare and integrity in college sports, critical of sports blogging culture, experienced in business management and corporate leadership, knowledgeable about college athletics and NCAA regulations, passionate about football, particularly University of Michigan football, engaged in discussions about social justice and equity, believes in the importance of education and community investment, critical of reactionary politics, supportive of progressive values, interested in urban development and the dynamics of city life, enjoys tabletop role-playing games (TTRPGs), has a technical background in IT, emphasizes the importance of critical thinking and informed discourse.
